confirm.title: Add {name}?
confirm.description: Add the G-Tag display connected through nRF52840.

user.title: Add a display or prepare firmware

zigbee.title: Connect through Zigbee2MQTT
zigbee.description: First pair the display in Zigbee2MQTT and install the GTag converter from this package. Configure the MQTT integration in HA.

firmware.title: Prepare firmware
firmware.description: Prepare a YAML configuration for ESPHome Device Builder 2026.9.0. Select the profile matching your board and bootloader. Compile and download the UF2 in ESPHome.

data_description.name: A unique name for each display: 1–31 lowercase letters, digits or hyphens; no leading or trailing hyphen.
data_description.board: Pro Micro / Super Mini: nice!nano S140 6.x bootloader. Super52840: stock XIAO S140 7.x, currently Zigbee only.

firmware_pins.title: Display wiring
firmware_pins.description: Check every GPIO against your wiring. Use P0.11 or P1.04 notation. Keep LCD power, common GND and the original DisplayCLK/S1 clock connected. Enable battery measurement only with an external 1 MΩ / 1 MΩ divider.

data.battery_enabled: Measure battery through an external divider

firmware_battery.title: Battery
firmware_battery.description: LiPo 1S up to 4.2 V, external 1 MΩ / 1 MΩ divider and 100 nF from the ADC input to GND. This profile does not support the built-in Super52840 divider. Charge is checked every five minutes while the radio is off.

data_description.calibration: Multimeter correction factor; start with 1.0, allowed range 0.8–1.2.
data_description.recovery_voltage: Above the radio-off threshold and at most the 100% voltage. This threshold also applies at every power-on.

firmware_download.title: Configuration ready
firmware_download.description:
{download_link_start}Download {filename}{download_link_end}

Firmware: **{firmware_tag}**. Use the link above to download. Submit performs the selected action; finishing shows the link again on the final screen and keeps it available for 20 minutes.

Create a configuration in ESPHome Device Builder and paste the YAML from the file. Select **Install → Manual download**, download the UF2 and copy it to the board bootloader drive. Zigbee also needs the converter from the same release. Then add the flashed display in GTag Display through Bluetooth or Zigbee2MQTT.

You can also copy the YAML:

```yaml
{yaml}
```

abort.bluetooth_not_ready: Bluetooth is unavailable. Check its setup in Home Assistant.

error.invalid_topic: Enter a base topic without leading/trailing slashes, + or #.
error.mqtt_not_ready: Set up the MQTT integration in Home Assistant first.
error.cannot_connect: No device inventory received. Check MQTT, Zigbee2MQTT and the base topic.
error.no_zigbee_devices: No new GTag displays found. Check pairing and Frame_V1 firmware.
error.converter_update_required: Update the gtag-display.mjs external converter in Zigbee2MQTT from this package.
error.unsupported_profile: Only Zigbee is currently available for Super52840.
error.invalid_device_name: Use 1–31 lowercase letters, digits or hyphens; no leading or trailing hyphen.
error.invalid_friendly_name: Enter 1–80 characters without line breaks or ESPHome substitutions.
error.reserved_gpio: This pin is reserved for the crystal, NFC or board reset.
error.duplicate_gpio: This GPIO is already used by another display signal.
error.invalid_adc_gpio: The ADC supports only P0.02…P0.05 and P0.28…P0.31.
error.invalid_full_voltage: The 100% threshold must exceed the 0% threshold by at least 1 mV.
error.invalid_recovery_voltage: Recovery must be above the 0% threshold and at most the 100% threshold.
error.firmware_download_unavailable: Unable to create the download link. Copy the YAML below or refresh the link.

init.title: Screen layout
init.description: Choose a layout. You can preview it before applying.

data_description.update_interval: Minimum pause between transfers, in seconds. Values update when their entities change; the clock updates once a minute. A longer pause reduces update frequency.
data_description.stale_after: Minutes without confirmation from HA; at least twice the update interval, rounded up to whole minutes. 0 disables the check. The icon inverts pixels in the upper-right corner. Requires updated firmware and Zigbee converter.

values.title: Display values
values.description: Choose the information to display. Empty labels and units use the entity's own name and unit.

data_description.label_1: Optional. Up to 80 characters; text fits the available space.
data_description.label_2: Optional. Up to 80 characters; text fits the available space.
data_description.unit_1: Optional. Up to 16 characters. Enter - to hide the unit.
data_description.unit_2: Optional. Up to 16 characters. Enter - to hide the unit.
data_description.decimals_1: Rounds numeric values on this screen only. For example, 1: 23.456 → 23.5; 0: 23.456 → 23. No rounding keeps the original value.
data_description.decimals_2: Rounds numeric values on this screen only. For example, 1: 23.456 → 23.5; 0: 23.456 → 23. No rounding keeps the original value.

preview.title: Preview screen
preview.description:
{preview}

This preview uses the current values. Apply saves the layout and sends it to the display. Edit returns to the settings; refresh updates the preview.

error.invalid_settings: Check the value and its allowed length or range.
error.stale_after_too_short: Enter at least {minimum} minutes to cover two update intervals, or 0 to disable the check.
error.invalid_entity: Display diagnostics cannot be used as a source for the screen.
error.render_failed: Unable to draw the preview. Edit the settings or check the Home Assistant log.
